status: Planned while probability collection is ongoing; exploratory, not a preregistration before any results were observed.
objective: Find the strongest defensible probe-to-LLM configuration and determine whether nearest-neighbour gains survive equal probability-threshold optimization.
comparators: Probe only, using the existing full-validation threshold rule and exact full-test metrics
Each hard-label explanation condition with a validation-tuned probe referral threshold
Each probability explanation condition with cutoff 50 and a validation-tuned probe threshold
Each probability explanation condition with jointly validation-tuned probe and judge probability thresholds
No-filter endpoint: probe threshold 0, so every eligible case is referred to the judge; sampled population estimates, not additional inference
primary_questions: Can the probability-tuned no-explanation pipeline match or exceed hard-label NN?
Does NN still help when no-explanation, saliency and NN ALL receive equal joint threshold tuning?
Does probability prompting plus validation threshold tuning help within each explanation condition relative to the parent hard-label prompt?
Which of the available configurations is preferred when the entire choice, including explanation and output format, is made on validation rather than test?

selection.thresholds: Use the frozen threshold grids and highest-threshold tie rule in PROTOCOL.json. No changes based on test performance.
selection.configuration: For each backbone-dataset-judge pair, select among the six core explanation/output configurations plus probe-only using validation F1. Report fixed-50 as an ablation. Disclose complete versus sampled validation support for probe-only versus judge pipelines. On F1 ties within 1e-12 prefer lower exact validation referral rate, then fixed deterministic order: probe-only, baseline-hard, baseline-probability, saliency-hard, saliency-probability, nearest-hard, nearest-probability. Probability configurations here use joint tuning.
selection.test: Report all fixed configurations and the validation-selected configuration on test. Test-best configurations may only be shown as explicitly optimistic descriptive upper bounds, never as held-out selections.

reporting: Macro-average equally over backbone-dataset-judge pairs; separate judge and backbone summaries and all ten dataset results; distinguish any micro aggregation and its weighting
F1, precision, recall, confusion counts, exact referral rates, judge prompt tokens and measured latency; paired changes in percentage points
Precision-recall and F1-versus-referral-rate curves; both fixed-50 and jointly tuned probability variants. Plot test frontiers as descriptive, with validation-selected operating points clearly marked

Cost-matched comparisons at predeclared referral budgets 10%,25%,50%,100%, choosing feasible policies on validation only; report actual test referral rate rather than implying exact test-budget matching
Win/tie/loss counts, effect distributions, explanation-by-output interactions, and consistency across judges, backbones and datasets
Descriptive score reliability, weighted Brier score, saturation at 0/100, rounding/heaping and overlap between positive and negative score distributions; probabilities are not assumed calibrated

Matched error transitions: recovered positives versus additional false positives, rejected false positives versus newly missed positives; stratify by frozen probe-score bands and dataset; inspect concrete NN-help/NN-hurt cases and neighbour label/probe agreement without claiming a causal mechanism
uncertainty: Preserve design weights and matched cases across conditions; report paired stratified test bootstrap intervals conditional on validation-selected thresholds

Add separately labelled sensitivity analysis that resamples validation within original strata, retunes thresholds and configuration, then evaluates on paired test resamples; census strata fixed, no source-group leakage

Treat shared cases/backbones/judges as correlated. For pooled uncertainty, use dataset-block resampling retaining all associated backbones/judges/conditions; state that only ten dataset blocks are available and avoid an IID-example interpretation
Show sample sizes, inclusion probabilities, extreme-threshold effective support and threshold-selection stability; distinguish pointwise intervals from simultaneous frontier claims
Avoid uncorrected significance fishing across the grid. If formal multiple tests are reported, define their family and apply a stated correction; emphasize effect sizes and uncertainty
limits: NN versus no explanation tests effectiveness; it does not distinguish retrieval-specific benefits from simply supplying a labelled example. Random-neighbour and label-only controls remain unrun.
Judge probability estimates are compared as elicited scores, not calibrated epistemic confidence.
Training, probes, masks, splits, explanations and sampled memberships remain frozen. No extra model calls or retraining are authorized by this analysis plan.
Do not claim universal Pareto dominance from a macro-average F1 improvement. Describe any precision/recall/cost trade-offs and dataset-specific reversals.
deliverables: Reproducible analysis scripts and checksummed machine-readable tables
Concise main comparison table with sample sizes, precision/recall/F1 and paired differences
Scientific plots showing trade-offs and heterogeneity
A clear conclusion about best validation-selected setups, where NN helps, whether probability thresholding removes its advantage, and what remains unresolved
